articles.title: UBS CEO says AI investors had been pricing for 'perfection' until sector's sharp correction
articles.description: UBS Chief Executive Sergio Ermotti commented on the recent downturn in AI stocks, attributing it to unrealistic expectations. He expressed optimism about the economic potential of AI, but cautioned that the timeline for advancements may be overstated. Recent US midterm elections raised concerns about stricter regulations impacting the AI sector's growth.
